assets.prompt:
Create a new image using the reference images as described.

ASSET: One landscape hero image for Afferent, a calm wordless morning game: the store feature graphic and the pitch title slide. It must stop a scrolling thumb: one frame that tells the whole story of the game, the colour returning to a frozen northern world, from blue polar night at the left to a honey sunrise at the right.

SUBJECT: A single continuous Finnish lake panorama. Read left to right as one unbroken passage of time: at the far left deep kaamos night in cyanotype blues, a few pin-point stars and one thin aurora veil in ice green; through the middle the blue lifts to dusk lilac #6E6590 and a frozen lake turns ice blue #8FC6E0; a small island of birches with leaves in birch gold sits in the middle distance; spruce green #2F4A48 fringes return on the right shore; at the far right a large honey #FFD58A sun just clears a laminated fell and lays one long soft sun path across the ice. The land is built from five to seven stacked layers like a paper diorama: far fells palest and bluest, each nearer layer a little deeper and more saturated, separated by thin bands of soft valley mist. In the foreground one long laminated snow ribbon, a single free curve like bent birch plywood, sweeps across the full width in a gentle rising wave toward the sun; its cut edge shows four thin parallel laminations in birch white #F2EEE6, birch ply #E2C79C and ply edge #B48E5C, catching the sunlight on the right half. The Keeper walks along the ribbon toward the sun at about 38 percent of the width, seen from behind and slightly to the side, tiny (about 6 percent of the frame height), lantern held forward, its long soft shadow stretching back toward the night. The Keeper, never facing the viewer: A small, round, child-sized figure about half as wide as it is tall. A thick felted wool cloak in birch ply #E2C79C. A smooth dome-shaped hood, perfectly round on top like an egg (no point, no tip, no ears, no pompom, no fur trim), flows straight into the cloak, which flares gently into a bell shape. The hood is seen from behind, no face visible. Near the bottom of the cloak runs a hem band of two thin parallel stripes in ply edge #B48E5C. Two small dark boot tips. Its lantern is a small dark iron lantern with a ring handle whose flame glows softly in honey #FFD58A. No scarf, no staff, no pole, no backpack.

COMPOSITION: 2:1 landscape, full bleed. Horizon at about 58 percent of the height from the top. The top 45 percent is open, calm sky with nothing in it except the faint aurora and stars at the left, so a wordmark can be set over it in code. The strongest contrast and the eye's landing point is the sun on the right third; the Keeper is the second focal point on the left-centre third, and the snow ribbon is the line that leads the eye from the Keeper to the sun. Generous negative space, no clutter, nothing cut awkwardly by the frame edges.

ART DIRECTION PRINCIPLES (principles only, never copy any game): layered atmospheric depth and one long continuous traversal line like Alto's Odyssey; restrained geometry and a calm, designed palette like Monument Valley; big flat fields of colour that change across the frame like Gris; a single small traveller in a vast quiet world facing one distant light like Journey.

RENDERING: Premium flat 2D key art in exactly the look of the approved concept plates: large calm shapes, smooth soft gradients, a big quiet sky that is a perfectly smooth gradient with no banding, no scanlines and no noise. Every landform, snowdrift and shoreline is one long unhurried free curve with laminated birch ply cut edges. A very fine felt-like micro-texture on snow and cloth only. Never a 3D render, never photoreal, never painterly brush work.

LIGHT AND COLOUR: The single warm focal light is the rising sun at the right; the Keeper's lantern is a small honey point. No lit windows, no village lights, no other warm points. Everything else cool. Warm light is only honey #FFD58A, sun yellow #F2C230 and dawn apricot #F3A57A, never orange-red, pink or coral.

AVOID: text, letters, numbers, logo, watermark, user interface, buttons, frame, border, vignette, faces or eyes, any other person or animal, buildings, lighthouse, red, pink, coral, magenta, neon, 3D render, plastic or glossy look, photorealism, brush texture, paper grain, sky banding, lens flare, white sun.
